identity.mission: Create a high-energy, cinematic, and colorful landing page that breaks the standard 'SaaS Dark Mode' convention while retaining professional credibility.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix 'Neo-Brutalist' shapes with 'Cinematic' lighting.
Emotion First: The page should feel like a creative studio—messy but organized, colorful but purposeful.
Content is King: The video categories and creator card are the heroes.
Contrast: High contrast between the clean white background and the deep, vivid brand colors.

typography.instructions: Use Poppins for EVERYTHING. Headings should be tight and bold. Body text should have relaxed line-height.

usage.background: Use pure white (#FFFFFF) for cards and #F8FAFC for the main page background to create subtle depth.
usage.text: Use Slate-900 (#0F172A) for headings and Slate-600 (#475569) for body text. Never use pure black.
usage.gradients: Use vivid gradients ONLY for text clips or button backgrounds, never for full sections. Example: 'bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-pink-500'.

overrides.Button: Use 'rounded-none' and the distinct shadow interaction defined above. Font-weight should be bold.
overrides.Card: Use 'bg-white' with a subtle border 'border-slate-200' and the sharp shadow.
overrides.Input: Sharp edges. Focus ring should be 'ring-2 ring-indigo-500 ring-offset-2'.

layout_strategy.spacing: Use comfortable spacing. Section padding: 'py-20' or 'py-24'. Element spacing: 'gap-6' or 'gap-8'.
layout_strategy.grid: Use Bento Grids (CSS Grid) for feature sections. Mix col-span-1 and col-span-2 cards.

principles: Scroll animations should be smooth and reveal content upwards.

hero.structure: Split layout or Centered. Big H1. Animated text. Background: Abstract colorful swirls or video production studio.
hero.description: Filmmaker's desk with camera and monitors. Use as a subtle background with overlay or as a side image.

categories.structure: Horizontal scrollable bar or wrapped pill list. High energy chips.

creator_card.structure: Central focus. A 'floating' card that looks like a simplified video editor interface.

features.description: Use this abstract swirl image as a background pattern or decoration for the features section.

social_proof.structure: Marquee of logos or grid of user testimonials.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use pure black (#000000). Use #0F172A.
Ensure 'Creator Card' functionality (input + generate) remains intact.
Avoid standard 'Bootstrap' layouts. Use asymmetry where possible.
